metadata.name: ManualCycle
metadata.description:
Cycling item pedestals (Glitched Crown, Tainted Isaac, Binge Eater, Soul of Isaac...) no longer change on their own. Stand next to one and press a key (C by default) to switch to the next item.
- Works on vanilla Repentance, REPENTOGON not required - External Item Descriptions: full Glitched Crown list, plus a "(1/2) C: Next Item" line - Mod Config Menu Pure: keyboard key, controller button, language, radius, co-op, Tainted Isaac, sound - Saved on run continue, co-op support, prices kept in shops and deal rooms - Translated into the 20 External Item Descriptions languages
